review_evidence: Brackin.thy: theory Brackin with datatype T (34 constructors) and mutually recursive datatypes TY1/TY2/TY3 from Brackin's protocol-logic work.

IsaFoR.thy: about 50 datatype (discs_sels) and type_synonym declarations for term rewriting (term, ctxt, pos, redtriple_impl, dp_termination_proof, trs_nontermination_proof, etc.) plus fun satisfied, collect_assms, collect_neg_assms.

Misc_N2M.thy: locales misc, mplicated, complicated; bnf_axiomatization of M0/N0/K0/L0/G0; many nested/mutual datatype and codatatype declarations with primrec and primcorec definitions and datatype_compat commands.

Find_Unused_Assms_Examples.thy: theory header importing Complex_Main, three sections with context notes blocks running find_unused_assms on Divides, GCD, Real, Fun, Relation, Set, Wellfounded, List, Map; no declarations, but formal diagnostic commands, retained under FILTER-021.

Needham_Schroeder_Base.thy: datatypes agent, key, msg, event; definitions agents, bad, synth'; fun invKey, find_first; inductive_set parts, analz, synth; primrec initState, knows, used; code lemmas (sorry) and code_pred setup.
Needham_Schroeder_Guided_Attacker_Example.thy: inductive_set ns_public with Fake_NS1/Fake_NS2/NS1-NS3 rules, quickcheck lemmas, and a full Isar proof validating the attack trace.
Needham_Schroeder_No_Attacker_Example.thy: inductive_set ns_public with NS1-NS3 rules, code_pred, two quickcheck lemma statements (oops).
Needham_Schroeder_Unguided_Attacker_Example.thy: inductive_set ns_public with Fake rule over synth (analz (spies evs)), quickcheck lemmas, and a full Isar proof of the counterexample trace.
Record_Benchmark.thy: record many_A (300 nat fields), record many_B extending it (31 fields), 13 lemmas about record update/selector simplification proved by simp/tactic, one notepad block.
summary: Read all 9 listed Isabelle theory files completely under src/Benchmarks (Datatype_Benchmark: 3, Quickcheck_Benchmark: 5, Record_Benchmark: 1). Eight files carry formal declarations (datatype, codatatype, type_synonym, fun, primrec, primcorec, inductive_set, definition, record, locale, lemma with proofs). Find_Unused_Assms_Examples.thy has no declarations of its own, but it runs find_unused_assms diagnostic commands against named HOL theories under quickcheck options; no auxiliary channel is verified for it, so under FILTER-002/FILTER-021 it stays retained. Disposition: retain all 9 files; no exclusions.
